headline: Egypt Broad Money Supply Rises to $296 Billion in September
summary: Egypt's broad money supply grew by 1.9% in September to reach approximately $296 billion, while net foreign assets in domestic banks declined by $4.1 billion.
why: Money supply and net foreign asset figures provide key insights into domestic liquidity conditions and external pressures facing a country's banking system.
